name: Se-n-se-i
source:
Sekimoto Akihiko is a private academy second grader descendant of powerful Sekimoto Heavy Industries. As new semester starts, he begins to feel a strong desire for the beauty of a female teacher who takes care of his class.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
